title: The file list: ListFiles and its files frame
spec: REQUIREMENTS 2.4 (the Files area). FEATURE_FILE_LIST (128); request 24 ListFiles (no fields), answered Ok { cursor: n } then a files frame (tag 135: u32 id | u16 n | n × (16 file | str room | u64 message cursor | str uploader | str name | u64 size | u8 has image | [u32 w | u32 h]), at most MAX_LISTED_FILES = 500; encode_files/decode_files refuse more, cut frames and trailing bytes). DurableServer::listed_files(user): every stored file attached to a live message in a room the user is in now, and every stored file of a live imported message there; never unposted uploads, files of deleted messages, files not archived, or rooms the user is not in; newest message cursor first, then room, then name. The memory backend answers E_NO_STORAGE. The client reads the frame as ClientEvent::Files. The network server advertises the feature.
